title: THE GALAPAGOS ISLANDS: A SPIRITUAL JOURNEY … Chapter 1 Photos (Day 1, Friday)

body:
I landed in Baltra, settled onto the Golondrina, and walked around the tiny, quiet island of Mosquera.

  

 For more photos of higher resolution, including videos, check out the whole album here.

 Here’s my Entry Card for the Galapagos Islands … 

 This makes it official!

 I’ve arrived!

  

 The walkway … made of solar panels.

  

  

 Dinghies come to transport us to the Golondrina …

  

 Frigate birds accompany us to our first excursion.

  

 Whale skeleton on a white beach made of … parrotfish poop!

  

  

 Our first dinner in the galley…

  

  

 Billy giving us an orientation to Isabela Island in the galley of the Golondrina

  

  

  

 For more about my book, The Galapagos Islands: A Spiritual Journey , click here:  https://fortresspress.com/thegalapagosislandsaspiritualjourney

 For UK readers, the title is  God Unbound: Theology in the Wild –  available here:  https://www.amazon.com/dp/1786222019
